claims.claim: AutoGrow starts from a shallow seed network.
AutoGrow grows layers when accuracy improves.
AutoGrow stops growing when additional depth no longer helps under the learned policy.
AutoGrow reports strong accuracy-computation trade-offs across several datasets.

open_questions: How does AutoGrow's performance compare to manual depth tuning on large-scale datasets?
What is the computational overhead of the layer-growing policy during training?
summary: AutoGrow proposes a method for automatically growing network depth during training, starting from a shallow seed, adding layers when accuracy improves, and stopping when further depth does not improve accuracy under a learned policy, demonstrating strong accuracy-computation trade-offs on multiple datasets.
